name: Matrix Eigenvalue Constraint Obfuscation
description: Replaces a simple bipartite inequality constraint ($s_u \neq s_v$) with a mathematically equivalent requirement that a $2 \times 2$ matrix formed by the two variables has a specific irrational eigenvalue. This masks the graph-coloring nature of the problem behind linear algebra, forcing the model to perform a non-obvious truth-table reduction to uncover the underlying XOR logic.
